title: [Media Coverage] “Genome Analysis Advances Through Language AI: From Word Translation to Understanding Grammar and Full Text” (Yomiuri Shimbun Online, August 6, 2026)
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Gen Tamiya, Team Director of the Statistical Genetics Team, was featured in Yomiuri Shimbun Online on August 6, 2026. ​​ The article highlights research related to the application of large language models (LLMs) to genome analysis. Advances in language AI are contributing to the development of new approaches for analyzing complex biological data.
